===============
Security Policy
===============

Supported versions
------------------

+---------+-------------+
| Version | Supported   |
+=========+=============+
| 2.3.x   | Yes         |
+---------+-------------+
| < 2.3   | No          |
+---------+-------------+

Reporting a vulnerability
-------------------------

.. This comment says nothing to readers: security@not-read.org

Please write to `the security team <mailto:security@octo-project.org>`_ and allow a week for an answer.
